## Snapshot checks

```{python}
#| label: snapshot-table
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
snapshot = json.loads(Path('data/atlas.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
rows = snapshot['rows']
lines = ['|Year|Dengue (210), recorded cases|Severe dengue (220), recorded cases|Weeks|',
         '|---|---:|---:|---:|']
for year in [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022]:
    totals = [sum(r['cases'] or 0 for r in rows if r['year']==year and r['event_code']==event) for event in ['210','220']]
    lines.append(f'|{year}|{totals[0]:,}|{totals[1]:,}|{53 if year==2020 else 52}|')
display(Markdown('\n'.join(lines)))
```

Counts above sum the mapped department records. Foreign and unknown geography
are excluded; Bogotá has no source rows. Event categories remain separate.
